Hi Elena —

Quick technical confirmation on encryption and subprocessors:

- Backups and object storage are encrypted at rest using customer-tenant keys managed in our KMS. We use AES-256 for storage encryption and envelope encryption with KMS for key wrapping.
- The subprocessors CSV lists our cloud provider (managed infra), analytics provider (telemetry), and a monitoring vendor. None have access to plaintext customer data; access is limited to metadata and telemetry.
- If you need a short bulletin for procurement summarizing encryption+subprocessor controls, I can produce a one-page memo by EOD tomorrow.

Also confirming: we received the DocuSign envelope and will complete signature to facilitate your PO issuance. Once you share the PO number, billing@redwood.com will accept and return an invoice with Redwood's vendor ID.
